newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINE BONDS RISE AS SPREADS TIGHTEN FURTHER.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINE BONDS RISE AS SPREADS TIGHTEN FURTHER.

text.p: Argentine bonds were higher late morning Wednesday, helped by a small upward correction in U.S. Treasuries, as spreads continued to tighten.
"The market is surprisingly firm," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Argentina's Par Brady bond was up 3/8 at 75, while the FRB bond was up 1/4 at 95-3/4.
Traders said activity was thin with no specific news boosting the market.
"It is the same things as always, talk of a (credit rating) upgrade and underlying market strength," which led to the gains, said another trader.
